limitations: STL contains no authoritative units; dimensions are interpreted as millimetres by project contract.
Exact-coordinate vertex welding is used only for analysis and does not rewrite the source.
Sampled wall thickness is not a complete global proof.
Standard 3MF structure does not prove destination-slicer slot mapping or vendor project metadata behavior.
Pairwise color-body overlap and clearance belong in an interface contract.
